feed.label: Feed
feed.unwatchConfirm: Stop watching {{source}} and remove its posts from the feed?
feed.empty: Open an account on X, Instagram, Threads, Bluesky, Mastodon or TikTok, a subreddit, or a page, profile or group on Facebook, and choose Watch from the menu. Its new posts will show up here, often without logging in.
feed.emptyDescription: Add profiles from these sites and their new posts show up here, often without logging in.
feed.emptyWatchHint: You can also open an account in a tab and choose Watch from the menu.
feed.loginHint: Some sources are checked without logging in, which can be delayed or blocked. Log in to {{sites}} in any Nora profile for more reliable updates.
feed.loggedOutSites: Some sources on {{sites}} are checked without logging in, which can be delayed or blocked. Log in to these sites in any Nora profile for more reliable updates.
feed.statusLoggedIn: Checked with the {{site}} account logged in to your {{profile}} profile.
feed.statusLoggedOutInProfile: Checked without logging in. Log in to {{site}} in your {{profile}} profile, or choose another profile in Feed settings, for more reliable updates.
feed.statusAccountsOff: Checked without logging in, as set in Feed settings.
feed.statusNeedsLoginAccountsOff: {{site}} asked you to log in. Nora will try again later; turn on Use my logins in Feed settings to keep this source updated.
feed.statusLoggedOut: Checked without logging in. Updates can be delayed; log in to {{site}} for more reliable ones.
feed.statusNeedsLogin: {{site}} asked you to log in. Nora will try again later; log in to {{site}} in any Nora profile to keep this source updated.
feed.statusRateLimited: {{site}} asked to slow down. Nora will try again in an hour.
feed.accountsOff: Not logged in (logins off in Feed settings)
feed.notificationPermissionDenied: Notifications are not allowed for Nora
feed.notifyTimelineHint: For the sources in this timeline that have no choice of their own. Only on this device.
feed.notifyFeedHint: For every source, unless its timeline or the source itself chooses otherwise. Only on this device.
feed.notifyMuted: Muted. No more notifications from this source.
feed.timelineIntervalHint: For the sources in this timeline that have no choice of their own.
feed.intervalHint: Applies to every source without its own choice. Checking less often saves battery and is less likely to be limited by the site.
feed.postsPerSourceHint: Older posts are removed once a source has more.
feed.useAccountsHint: Checks {{sites}} sources with the account you're logged in to in a Nora profile. Updates are more reliable, but the site sees which accounts you follow this way.
feed.mediaUsage: {{used}} of {{limit}} used. Media of the oldest posts is removed first.
feed.mediaClearConfirm: Remove all photos and videos kept for the feed? They are downloaded again when needed.
feed.deleteTimelineConfirm: Delete the timeline {{name}}? Its sources stay watched, in All sources.
feed.showOnNewTab: Show Feed on new tab page
feed.timelineEmpty: No sources in this timeline yet.
feed.timelineSourcesHint: Tick the sources to show in {{name}}. A source is in one timeline at a time, so ticking one from another timeline moves it here.
feed.addSourcesHint: Paste profile links, one per line, from these sites.
feed.addSourcesUnrecognized: Not a profile link that can be watched
